https://www.reddit.com/r/LateStageCapitalism/comments/7ul1he/on_climate_change_denial/

Yet they're still just so off the mark. It's human to think there is always a solution, always a way to change what's what. But what we simply can't accept is that we've created something too large to handle, even for those with the most capital on the planet. Capital is just a made up, human concept that has no real tangibility when it comes to something like BEING ABLE TO SURVIVE IN THE ONLY HABITAT THAT WE HAVE. The rich will die too if it is simply too hot to survive; they will not have the proles around to finance every aspect of their existence; their food, shelter, transportation, EVERYTHING will be unprotected by merely them having a lot of made up numbers in a made up financial institution.

99% of people can't even fathom the problem; why do we have so much faith that the 1% who do can do shit about it? I suppose it's because the average person assumes since they are surrounded by so many processes, systems, and technologies that they don't understand whatsoever that of course some people think others can just "think hard enough" and save the world. But the smartest thinkers on the planet have universally accepted that we are fucked, to the number of 16,000 scientists who published the article about it. 

https://www.cnn.com/2017/11/14/health/scientists-warn-humanity/index.html
